definition_zh: 市民；（欧洲中世纪的）城镇自由民；殷实市民
definition_en: a citizen of a town or borough, especially a prosperous town dweller of medieval Europe
core_image: 戴毡帽的镇上商人，在公会厅前踱步
scene: 镇公会厅里，殷实市民们表决新桥的税款。The burghers of the town agreed to fund the new bridge.
sceneCN: 这里 burgher 是「市民、镇上有产者」（第 1 个义项：拥有市民权的城镇居民）；句意是镇上的市民们同意出资修新桥。

pos.zh: 市民；城镇自由民；有产市民

derivatives.zh: 同族词，义为「自治市镇」（英语本土形式）
同族词，义为「市民；（英史）自治市议员」
法语同源词，义为「中产阶级者；市民阶层的一分子」

senses.title: A town citizen
senses.definition: an inhabitant of a borough who holds full civic rights
senses.definitionCN: 享有完整市民权的镇区居民
senses.example: Only burghers could vote in the town assembly.
senses.exampleCN: 只有市民才能在镇民大会上投票。
senses.why: The Germanic root names the fortified place; its qualified residents take the name.
senses.whyCN: 日耳曼词根指设防之地，其合格居民遂以此为称。

senses.title: A prosperous town dweller
senses.titleCN: 殷实市民；体面的镇上人家
senses.definition: a comfortably off, stolid member of the town middle class
senses.definitionCN: 镇上小康而持重的中产人士
senses.example: The painter scorned the tastes of the wealthy burghers.
senses.exampleCN: 画家看不惯富商市民的品味。
senses.why: Civic standing implied property, so the word drifted toward class meaning.
senses.whyCN: 市民身份意味着有产，词义遂滑向阶层含义。

senses.title: A Boer settler in South Africa
senses.definition: in South African history, a full citizen of a Boer republic
senses.definitionCN: 南非历史上布尔共和国的正式公民
senses.example: The burghers mustered at the river crossing.
senses.why: Dutch settlers kept the civic term for citizens of their own republics.
senses.whyCN: 荷兰裔移民沿用这一市民称呼指本国公民。

intro.en: Burgher is borough dressed in Dutch-German clothes: the fortified town and its citizen.
intro.cn: burgher 是 borough 的荷德语装束：设防城镇及其市民。

items.en: a reconstructed root bhergh meant high, then a fortified height.
items.cn: 重构词根 bhergh 意为高，引申为筑于高处的堡垒。

items.en: burg meant a hill fort, then a walled town.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 burg 先指山寨，后指城墙城镇。

items.en: borghere and Bürger named the full citizen of such a town.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 borghere、德语 Bürger 指城镇正式公民。

items.en: burgher entered English for citizens of continental and Boer towns.
items.cn: 十六至十八世纪 burgher 进入英语，指欧陆及布尔城镇的市民。

items.en: burgher survives in historical and South African contexts.
items.cn: 如今 burgher 存留于历史语境与南非英语。

note.en: Burgher heads the whole burg family of towns and citizens.
note.cn: burgher 是整个 burg 城镇词族的带头者。

entries.definition: a town or district with local government
entries.definitionCN: 自治市镇，同根英语本土形式
市民；自治市代表，同根词
汉堡包，发音相同但词源完全无关

entries.definition: a member of the town middle class
a legal member of a city or state
one holding civic freedom of a town
a male resident of a town

normalIntro.en: The burgh is the walled town; its qualifying dwellers are burghers.
normalIntro.cn: burgh 是设防城镇，够格的居民便是 burghers。

normal.en: Borough, burg, burger, burgher — one family, four costumes.
Burger the sandwich is a false cousin.
normal.cn: 汉堡包那个 burger 是冒牌亲戚。

normal.en: German Bürger still means citizen today.
normal.cn: 德语 Bürger 至今仍指公民。

normal.en: Edinburgh keeps the old burgh spelling.
normal.cn: 爱丁堡 Edinburgh 保留着古体 burgh。

normal.en: Boer burghers were citizens of their republics.
normal.cn: 布尔 burghers 是其共和国的公民。

abstract.en: See guild banners hang over a cobbled square.
abstract.cn: 看见行会旗帜挂在鹅卵石广场上空。

abstract.en: Hear the town bell call the assembly.
Feel heavy keys of a burgher's shop door.
abstract.cn: 感受市民店铺大门上沉甸甸的钥匙。

examples.en: The burghers protested the new wall tax.
examples.cn: 市民们抗议新征的城墙税。
伦勃朗画下了阿姆斯特丹自豪的市民。

examples.en: Boer burghers served in the commando system.
examples.cn: 布尔公民在民团体系中服役。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泊阁」——市民的宅子在镇上「泊」着如「阁」楼，安稳殷实。

root: burgher 经由中古荷兰语 borghere、德语 Bürger，源自日耳曼语 burg（设防之地，上溯原始印欧语重构词根 bhergh「高、堡垒」），与英语 borough、burg 同根异形，指「拥有城镇市民权者」。

sensesIntro.en: The citizen of a walled town first means full civic rights, then comfortable property, and in South Africa a republican citizen.
sensesIntro.cn: 设防城镇的市民，先指完整市民权，继而指殷实有产，在南非则指共和国公民。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a walled town and its key-holding citizens.
core.cn: 核心意象：城墙环绕的城镇与握有钥匙的市民。

branches.cn: 集结为民团的布尔公民

intro.en: Burgher adds the person suffix to the town root: the town made human.
intro.cn: burgher 在城镇词根上加指人后缀：把城镇变成人。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic; Latin offered no rival except civis.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属日耳曼语源，拉丁语只有 civis 可作对照。

items.exampleCN: 哥特语 bairgs（如词源所示）

latinEntries.meaningCN: 公民（citizen 与 civic 之源，同义场对照）
